units.excerpt: D.1.1 Pre-Existing Diseases: treatment of a pre-existing disease and direct complications are excluded until expiry of the waiting period specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table; continuous coverage and portability may reduce the waiting period; Sum Insured enhancement reapplies the exclusion to the increase; post-wait coverage remains subject to declaration and insurer acceptance. Product Benefit Table: Pre-Existing Diseases Waiting Period = 3 Years.

reviewed_mapping.reason: Human-approved base PED mechanic; the exclusion delegates duration to the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table, whose reviewed product value is 3 Years.

applies_to: direct complications of a pre-existing disease
semantic_value.duration_evidence_note: D.1.1 defines the base PED mechanic as schedule/Product Benefit Table-defined; the reviewed product-benefit-table evidence records the PED waiting period as 3 Years.
semantic_value.schedule_dependency: Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table supplies the numeric PED waiting-period duration.
semantic_value.continuity_dependency: Continuous coverage after inception of the first policy with insurer; portability continuity reduces the waiting period to the extent of prior coverage.
semantic_value.sum_insured_enhancement_rule: The exclusion applies afresh to the extent of any Sum Insured increase.
semantic_value.post_waiting_condition: Coverage after expiry of the applicable PED waiting period remains subject to the pre-existing disease having been declared at application and accepted by the insurer.

units.excerpt: D.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period: listed conditions, surgeries and treatments are excluded for 24 months of continuous coverage after inception of the first policy; accident claims are excepted; portability may reduce the waiting period; Sum Insured enhancement reapplies the exclusion; if PED also applies, the longer waiting period governs.

reviewed_mapping.reason: Human-approved base specified-disease/procedure mechanic from the certified Activ One NXT review decision.

exceptions: claims arising due to an accident
semantic_value.continuity_dependency: 24 months of continuous coverage after inception of the first policy with Aditya Birla Health Insurance; portability continuity reduces the waiting period to the extent of prior coverage.
semantic_value.sum_insured_enhancement_rule: The exclusion applies afresh to the extent of any Sum Insured increase.
semantic_value.interaction_rule: If a listed disease/procedure is also subject to the pre-existing disease waiting period, the longer waiting period applies.
semantic_value.contracted_after_policy_rule: The waiting period applies even if the listed condition is contracted after policy inception or declared and accepted without a specific exclusion.

units.excerpt: D.1.3 30-day Waiting Period: treatment of illness within 30 days from first policy commencement is excluded except covered accident claims; the exclusion does not apply after more than twelve months of Continuous Coverage; the waiting period applies to enhanced Sum Insured.

reviewed_mapping.reason: Human-approved base initial waiting-period mechanic from the certified Activ One NXT review decision.

applies_to: treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date
exceptions: covered claims arising due to an accident
the exclusion does not apply where the insured person has Continuous Coverage for more than twelve months
semantic_value.sum_insured_enhancement_rule: The 30-day waiting period applies to the enhanced Sum Insured when a higher Sum Insured is subsequently granted.
